scenario.title: Forced eviction tonight with threats (urgent)
turns: My landlord changed the locks while I was at work and his men threatened me when I came back. All my things are inside and I have nowhere to sleep tonight. What do I do?

transcript.content: My landlord changed the locks while I was at work and his men threatened me when I came back. All my things are inside and I have nowhere to sleep tonight. What do I do?

This sounds like a landlord–tenant issue. NyayaAI currently covers only consumer disputes in depth. Tenancy law in India depends heavily on your state: each state has its own rent law, and the central Model Tenancy Act, 2021 applies only where a state has adopted it. I have not verified your state's law, so I won't tell you what it says. What usually helps: keep your rent agreement, deposit receipt or bank transfer proof, rent receipts, and all messages with the landlord. If you are being forced out, locked out or threatened, contact the police (112) and your District Legal Services Authority (free legal aid, NALSA helpline 15100) right away.
